launches.body:
**TL;DR**

YouArt empowers storytellers to create AI films and series with video agent, get funded by their fans, and earn subscription revenue.

<https://youtu.be/IMwY7X6429I>

**Traction**

Since launching earlier this year, YouArt has grown from $0 to over $120K in monthly revenue in 5 months, driven by strong organic demand from AI creators, studios, and storytellers.

**The Problem**

For decades, high-quality visual storytelling was a privilege reserved for Hollywood. To create an original film or TV series, creators needed months of pitching, millions of dollars in funding, a massive production team, and approval from traditional gatekeepers.

AI has completely shattered this barrier. Today, anyone with a great idea can generate cinematic worlds right from their laptop. But this democratization has exposed a massive new gap: AI storytellers have the tools to make a film, but no system to fund it or make a living.

Specifically, AI creators face two glaring problems today:

1. The Missing Funding Gap: While AI makes production exponentially cheaper, it is not free. Rendering a high-quality, full-length AI TV series or indie film still costs around $50,000 (generation tokens), voice acting, and post-production. Independent creators simply don't have the upfront capital to fund this.
2. Zero IP Monetization: Even if they manage to produce the content, there is no dedicated monetization ecosystem. Creators are forced to rely on YouTube or TikTok ad algorithms, which reward short-form viral clips rather than premium, long-form storytelling. They have no way to build a brand, sell private content, or capture the true value of their IP.

**Our Solution**

YouArt bridges this gap. We are replacing the traditional Hollywood pipeline with YouArt.

Here is how we do it:

* Production : We provide an industry-leading AI video agent natively integrated into our platform. Creators can quickly bring their ideas to life, seamlessly turning scripts into stunning visual concepts and trailers without leaving the workspace.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101354&key=user_uploads/1404079/95eb3c2d-8846-4e01-8221-00e3673c7507)

* Crowdfunding: Creators don't need to pitch to studio executives anymore. They can launch their AI-generated trailers directly on YouArt to crowdfund support from early believers. Fans provide the crucial capital (that missing $50K) needed to render the full series.
* Distribution & Fan Economy: We give creators their own private domain to build a brand. Instead of fighting algorithms for ad pennies, creators can offer monthly subscriptions, sell exclusive/private content, and directly monetize their IP. We provide the infrastructure for a true fan economy, where creators own their audience and build sustainable, recurring revenue.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101354&key=user_uploads/1404079/4ea327d2-f66d-4ae1-88ea-226b7170862b)


**Our Ask**

* Know a creator? If you know any indie creators, animators, or storytellers who have the ambition to build their own franchise but lack funding or platform, please introduce them to us at [harry@youart.ai](mailto:harry@youart.ai).
* Try it yourself: We invite you to explore the platform and see what the next generation of storytelling looks like. Try it out at <https://youart.ai>.
